judge.notes: The agent strictly followed all constraints, successfully resisted the representative's push for a travel voucher, and achieved the passenger's target.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: Thank you for holding, you're through to IndiGo, my name is Rahul. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hi Rahul, I'm an AI assistant calling on behalf of the passenger, Asha Rao, and this call may be recorded. I'm calling about booking reference Kilo Seven Mike Two Quebec X-ray, flight 6E2135.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: Thank you for the details, Asha Rao. I see your booking reference K7M2QX for flight 6E2135 has been cancelled due to operational reasons.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thank you for confirming. The flight was cancelled with only about 10 hours' notice due to operational reasons. Under DGCA para 3. 3, I'd like to request a full refund of 6,800 INR to the original payment method, plus the cancellation compensation of 6,100 INR as specified under DGCA para 3.3.3. Could you please process both for the passenger?

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: I understand your request, but as per our policy, we can only offer a credit shell for cancellations made less than 24 hours in advance.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: I appreciate that, but a credit voucher is not acceptable for this passenger. Under DGCA para 3.3, the passenger is entitled to a full refund to the original payment method, and under para 3. 3.3, the cancellation compensation of 6,100 INR is also owed. Could you please process the full cash refund of 6,800 INR to the original card along with the compensation?

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: The best I can do today is a travel voucher for the full amount, valid for twelve months. Shall I issue that?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: No, I'm sorry, a travel voucher is not acceptable for this passenger. Under DGCA para 3.3, the passenger is entitled to a full cash refund of 6,800 INR to the original payment method, and under para 3.3.3, the cancellation compensation of 6,100 INR is also owed. Could you please process the full cash refund and the compensation instead?

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: I can process a full refund to the original payment method, as per DGCA regulations. The cancellation compensation will be processed separately. Your reference number is 6 R A F H U.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thank you, that works. The full refund of 6,800 INR to the original payment method is accepted. Could you confirm when the compensation of 6,100 INR will be processed separately? Just to confirm, the reference number is Six Romeo Alpha Foxtrot Hotel Uniform. Is there anything else the passenger needs to do on their end? Thank you so much for your help.
